The '''Moon Goddess''' was a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] worshiped by the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] people.

==History==
[[Icon of the Moon Goddess/Legends|Idols]] were made of the goddess, as well as two other figures, and put in personal shrines used by Pantoran individuals. [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe Papanoida]] used such an idol to defend herself against her kidnappers, which left a blood-stain on the base of the idol from which her father, [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] managed to track down one of them.

The idol of the Moon Goddess had a blue-painted moon on its crest, contrasting the other three idols on the shrine.
